en: He was one of those guy retiring types on the outside, but nothing could be further from the truth.
zh: 他表面上看起來像是那種即將退休的人，但事實完全不是這樣。
ja: 彼は外見上は引退間近のタイプの一人でしたが、実際は全く違いました。
local: He was one of those guy retiring types on the outside, but nothing could be further from the truth.
ja_pron: Kare wa gaikenjō wa intai majika no taipu no hitori deshita ga, jissai wa mattaku chigaimashita.
native: He was one of those guy retiring types on the outside, but nothing could be further from the truth.

en: He had a calling for this mountain. It was a special mountain for him that he had to play.
zh: 他對這座山有一種使命感。這座山對他來說很特別，他必須征服它。
ja: 彼にはこの山に対する使命感がありました。この山は彼にとって特別なもので、挑まなければならなかったのです。
local: He had a calling for this mountain. It was a special mountain for him that he had to play.
ja_pron: Kare ni wa kono yama ni taisuru shimeikan ga arimashita. Kono yama wa kare ni totte tokubetsu na mono de, idomanakereba naranakatta no desu.
native: He had a calling for this mountain. It was a special mountain for him that he had to play.

en: When I was crossing into a vassalage, number I stayed away, which I was standing.
zh: 當我穿越封地時，我保持距離，站在一旁。
ja: 私が封地を越えるとき、距離を保ち、立っていました。
local: When I was crossing into a vassalage, number I stayed away, which I was standing.
ja_pron: Watashi ga fūchi o koeru toki, kyori o tamochi, tatte imashita.
native: When I was crossing into a vassalage, number I stayed away, which I was standing.

en: I was tensing he was following, had the right height and a very short time, and pulled me upside into a very far.
zh: 我緊張著，他跟隨著，身高合適，時間很短，然後把我拉向一個很遠的地方。
ja: 私は緊張していましたが、彼はついてきて、適切な高さで短い時間のうちに私を遠くへ引き上げました。
local: I was tensing he was following, had the right height and a very short time, and pulled me upside into a very far.
ja_pron: Watashi wa kinchō shite imashita ga, kare wa tsuite kite, tekisetsu na takasa de mijikai jikan no uchi ni watashi o tōku e hikiagemashita.
native: I was tensing he was following, had the right height and a very short time, and pulled me upside into a very far.

en: He said he was out in front, cutting these steps, great sheets of snow and ice, breaking loose and just taking off down the steep slope.
zh: 他說他在前面開路，切開這些階梯，大片的雪和冰塊鬆動，然後順著陡坡滑下去。
ja: 彼は前に出て、階段を切り開き、大きな雪と氷の層が崩れ、急な斜面を滑り降りたと言いました。
local: He said he was out in front, cutting these steps, great sheets of snow and ice, breaking loose and just taking off down the steep slope.
ja_pron: Kare wa mae ni dete, kaidan o kiri hiraki, ōkina yuki to kōri no sō ga kuzure, kyū na shamen o suberi orita to iimashita.
native: He said he was out in front, cutting these steps, great sheets of snow and ice, breaking loose and just taking off down the steep slope.

en: He started having some doubts, whether it was safe to go on and the little voice within him spoke up and it was Ed Maboy.
zh: 他開始有些懷疑，是否繼續前進是安全的，內心的小聲音響起，那是艾德·馬博伊。
ja: 彼は先に進むのが安全かどうか疑い始め、心の中の小さな声が聞こえました。それはエド・マボイでした。
local: He started having some doubts, whether it was safe to go on and the little voice within him spoke up and it was Ed Maboy.
ja_pron: Kare wa saki ni susumu no ga anzen ka dō ka utagai hajime, kokoro no naka no chiisana koe ga kikoemashita. Sore wa Edo Maboi deshita.
native: He started having some doubts, whether it was safe to go on and the little voice within him spoke up and it was Ed Maboy.

en: This is Everest. Sometimes you've got to be prepared to push it a lot harder, and he looked down at tensing and they both smiled at each other and nodded and they kept on going.
zh: 這就是珠穆朗瑪峰。有時你必須準備更加努力，他看著騰辛，他們相視一笑，點頭，繼續前進。
ja: ここがエベレストです。時にはもっと頑張る覚悟が必要で、彼はテンシングを見下ろし、二人は笑い合い、うなずいて進み続けました。
local: This is Everest. Sometimes you've got to be prepared to push it a lot harder, and he looked down at tensing and they both smiled at each other and nodded and they kept on going.
ja_pron: Koko ga Eberesuto desu. Toki ni wa motto ganbaru kakugo ga hitsuyō de, kare wa Tenshingu o mioroshi, futari wa waraiai, unazuite susumi tsuzukemashita.
native: This is Everest. Sometimes you've got to be prepared to push it a lot harder, and he looked down at tensing and they both smiled at each other and nodded and they kept on going.

en: Tensing who can speak no English is asked his reaction as to his magnificent achievement.
zh: 不會說英語的騰辛被問及對他偉大成就的反應。
ja: 英語を話せないテンシングに、彼の素晴らしい達成についての感想を尋ねました。
local: Tensing who can speak no English is asked his reaction as to his magnificent achievement.
ja_pron: Eigo o hanasenai Tenshingu ni, kare no subarashii tassei ni tsuite no kansō o tazunemashita.
native: Tensing who can speak no English is asked his reaction as to his magnificent achievement.

en: I think what he wanted. He's very happy.
zh: 我想他想要的就是這個。他非常高興。
ja: 彼が望んでいたことだと思います。彼はとても幸せです。
local: I think what he wanted. He's very happy.
ja_pron: Kare ga nozonde ita koto da to omoimasu. Kare wa totemo shiawase desu.
native: I think what he wanted. He's very happy.

en: 5,000 Indians clam around the aircraft to catch a glimpse of the two who reached the summit.
zh: 五千名印度人圍繞飛機，想一睹兩位登頂者的風采。
ja: 5000人のインド人が飛行機の周りに群がり、頂上に到達した二人を一目見ようとしました。
local: 5,000 Indians clam around the aircraft to catch a glimpse of the two who reached the summit.
ja_pron: 5000-nin no Indo-jin ga hikōki no mawari ni muragari, chōjō ni tōtatsu shita futari o hitome miyō to shimashita.
native: 5,000 Indians clam around the aircraft to catch a glimpse of the two who reached the summit.

en: The shock when all of a sudden messages started coming in, congratulations from Prime Ministers and all sorts of other people.
zh: 當突然開始收到來自總理和各方人士的祝賀訊息時，大家都感到震驚。
ja: 突然、首相や様々な人々からの祝福のメッセージが届き始めたときの衝撃。
local: The shock when all of a sudden messages started coming in, congratulations from Prime Ministers and all sorts of other people.
ja_pron: Totsuzen, shushō ya samazama na hitobito kara no shukufuku no messēji ga todoki hajimeta toki no shōgeki.
native: The shock when all of a sudden messages started coming in, congratulations from Prime Ministers and all sorts of other people.

en: She was a hope for millions of people around the world. In India he was worshipped by the people.
zh: 她是全世界數百萬人的希望。在印度，他受到人民的崇敬。
ja: 彼女は世界中の何百万人もの人々の希望でした。インドでは彼は人々に崇拝されていました。
local: She was a hope for millions of people around the world. In India he was worshipped by the people.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa sekaijū no nanbyakuman-nin mo no hitobito no kibō deshita. Indo de wa kare wa hitobito ni sūhai sarete imashita.
native: She was a hope for millions of people around the world. In India he was worshipped by the people.

en: Building schools and hospitals. He was an incredible man and he was an amazing father.
zh: 建造學校和醫院。他是一位了不起的人，也是令人敬佩的父親。
ja: 学校や病院を建てました。彼は素晴らしい人であり、素敵な父親でした。
local: Building schools and hospitals. He was an incredible man and he was an amazing father.
ja_pron: Gakkō ya byōin o tatemashita. Kare wa subarashii hito de ari, suteki na chichioya deshita.
native: Building schools and hospitals. He was an incredible man and he was an amazing father.

en: The true joy him to him after climbing Everest was giving back to the people that lived in the Himalayas.
zh: 他攀登珠穆朗瑪峰後真正的喜悅，是回饋生活在喜馬拉雅山的人們。
ja: エベレスト登頂後の彼の本当の喜びは、ヒマラヤに住む人々に恩返しをすることでした。
local: The true joy him to him after climbing Everest was giving back to the people that lived in the Himalayas.
ja_pron: Eberesuto tōchōgo no kare no hontō no yorokobi wa, Himaraya ni sumu hitobito ni ongaeshi o suru koto deshita.
native: The true joy him to him after climbing Everest was giving back to the people that lived in the Himalayas.
